provenance.durationSemanticsNote: finalDurationMs is spell_data_t::_duration plus every duration modifier from an SX_PASSIVE spell of the Blood specialization (specialization_spells.inc, class 6 spec 250), which SimulationCraft applies through parse_all_class_passives (player.cpp:16363-16388) before buff_t::set_duration reads get_passive_value( data(), "duration" ) (buff.cpp:852-880). Not haste-scaled (no SX_DURATION_HASTED aura is modelled), not build-dependent: an aura carrying a modifier from any other spell fails extraction.
provenance.remainsModelNote: FIXED_DURATION_RESET_ON_GAIN: buff_t::increment starts the buff with the full duration when inactive (buff.cpp:2428-2470) and otherwise calls refresh, whose DURATION behaviour reschedules the expiry to the full duration (buff.cpp:1900-1906, 2532-2578); decrement never touches the expiry (buff.cpp:2246-2290). The behaviour is DURATION when the spell carries neither SX_REFRESH_EXTENDS_DURATION nor SX_AURA_DOES_NOT_REFRESH (buff.cpp:725-757, 1635-1660) and no periodic effect makes it tick (buff.cpp:1204-1243). PERMANENT: a non-positive _duration clamps to zero (buff.cpp:876-879), no expiration is scheduled (buff.cpp:2456-2458) and remains() is timespan_t::min() while active (buff.cpp:2018-2029).
provenance.applicabilityNote: Not version-gated at runtime: CombatFight exposes no client-build key. The build is recorded for traceability; a client build moving is a regeneration trigger for a human.
